svg.title: VIGOR: reviving cloud gaming sessions
svg.desc: Frame t of a cloud-gamed scene arrives with missing macroblocks. The decoder marks them with a mask, and the client renders lightweight game states (projected object points) for frames t−1 and t. Optical flow computed from the game states warps frame t−1; enhancement and inpainting fill content that warping cannot reach, and the correctly decoded blocks of frame t are kept, giving the recovered frame.

g.text: Late or lost packets corrupt frame t
Decoder mask + game states on the client
Optical flow from game states t−1 → t
Warp t−1, enhance + inpaint, keep decoded
